**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 5 (the fixes).** Stage 4's review is whole (`docs/perf/performance-review.md`, ending in `## floor`).

**A loaded file no longer copies its parent's require chain.** `resolve_program` in `crates/nvs-hir/src/requires.rs` carries a depth per file on `work`, keeps one chain cut back to that depth on pop, and a set of the same paths for the cycle check. Ladder `benches/scaling/compiler/requires.nvs` (n files each requiring the next and a shared file) is flat on the old and new binary; the clock could not separate them even at 16384 files. Figures in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What got better*. Its gap record is deleted.

**A `compile` ladder may now print several files**: a `// scaling: file <name>.nvs` line in its output starts a file written beside the program (`printedFiles` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts`, README in `benches/scaling/README.md`).

**12 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** keep `owners --closes performance-pass` red (`bun nv owners --closes performance-pass` lists them). `bun nv scaling --check` was red at the last sweep and was not re-run this session; read its output first next session. *Decisions for you* in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` has two entries: a total deadline for the request head, and `Markup` concatenation in place.
